The Kiko’s Story

Kiko isn’t just our name - Kiko is a beloved dog who’s been part of our family since before our sister hostel “Wanderlust” even opened. She greeted backpackers, kept staff company during late-night paint jobs, and somehow managed to make everyone feel at home. When we created this space, we knew exactly what we wanted it to feel like: warm, friendly, and welcoming - just like Kiko.

Kiko’s Hostel is our tribute to that spirit. We’re newly decorated, thoughtfully designed, and located a short walk from the main pier, Thong Sala Night Market, Phangan Food Court, Art Market, and the beach. Come for the comfort, stay for the community - and if you make it over to Wanderlust, say hi to the original Kiko for us :)

Our Vibe

🌿 Calm & Social

We’re a clean, friendly, and social hostel - not a party spot. Expect relaxed hangs, new friends, and quiet hours for a great night’s sleep.

🧘‍♀️ Balance is Key

Explore Koh Phangan’s wellness side: yoga, meditation, Thai massage, and peaceful beaches - with chill zones for every mood.

🤝 Community First

Connect with travelers from around the world and our local Thai team for authentic tips - from Muay Thai gyms to the best local food.

Shine: The Founder of Kiko’s

Meet Shine - the friendly force behind Kiko’s. With a passion for connection and community, Shine helped shape Kiko’s into a space that’s modern, welcoming, and full of heart. Whether sharing local tips or a good story, he makes guests feel right at home.

Shine’s Journey

✨ Built Kiko’s to bring people together in a relaxed setting

🌱 Grew a community around comfort, cleanliness, and culture

🌏 Loves connecting travelers with authentic local experiences

💬 Known for warm hosting and great island recommendations

“Kiko reminds us that home is a feeling. If you leave with new friends and a full heart, we’ve done our job.”

What Makes Us Special

Accommodation Options

Modern Dorms

Privacy curtains, reading lights, outlets, key card access

Female-Only Options

Comfortable, secure spaces (subject to availability)

Spaces to Connect

Indoor lounge with Smart TV, outdoor terrace, and a communal kitchenette with microwave, big fridge, hot/cold water - plus free tea and coffee all day.

Location Advantage

Short walk to the pier, Night Market, Phangan Food Court, Art Market, and the beach - no scooter needed. Want to explore waterfalls and viewpoints? We’ll help arrange a reliable bike rental.

Smart Timing

For calmer vibes and better rates, visit between Full Moon periods. During Full Moon, the island is busier and prices are higher.
